summaryParagraphs: Innovative full-stack and ML engineer with 5+ years of experience across design, development, testing, and deployment. I build production software with strong emphasis on clear algorithms, reliable backends, and deep learning where it fits—from CNNs and LSTMs to transformers and sequence models—using Python, JavaScript, C++, C#, and related ecosystems.

I translate product requirements into maintainable systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), with hands-on DevOps practice: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and tooling that keeps teams shipping safely. I care about measurable outcomes—for example, cutting debugging time with better workflows and developer tools.

services.title: Full-stack & APIs
services.text: End-to-end web applications with React, Django, ASP.NET, Angular, and Node-style stacks; RESTful and real-time APIs, payment integrations, and secure e-commerce flows.

services.title: Machine learning
services.text: Deep learning for SaaS products: CNNs, LSTMs, transformers, and sequence models with PyTorch and Keras, deployed on AWS and integrated with modern front ends.

services.title: Cloud & DevOps
services.text: CI/CD pipelines and platform work with Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Linux, Nginx, and major clouds—so teams can ship iteratively with observability and sane release discipline.

services.title: Data & integration
services.text: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Selenium-driven data extraction, CRM and operations tooling, and automation for billing and business workflows.

experience.title: Software Engineer
paragraphs: Developed an AI-based SaaS platform with CNN, LSTM, Transformer, and other sequence models on AWS using React, Django, PyTorch, Keras, and Python.
Developed a web application using C++, C#, JavaScript, ASP.NET, and AngularJS that allowed users to upload and search files in cloud storage (Elasticsearch).

Participated in the design and implementation of CI/CD and DevOps for agile projects using Python, JavaScript, Node.js, Git, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Nginx, Jenkins, and AWS; used tools such as React DevTools to speed up debugging and reduce debugging time by about 50%.

experience.title: Software Engineer
paragraphs: Developed an API using C++, C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and SignalR that integrated with a third-party payment processor and enabled real-time chat and secure, reliable transactions for an e-commerce platform.

Developed a Customer Relationship Management system and company management tooling to track inventory, manage the supply chain, and analyze and extract data from competitor websites using C++, C#, .NET Framework, SQL Server, Selenium, WCF, .NET Core, Angular, and Azure Active Directory.

Maintained a large web application using HTML/CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and PHP (Laravel); automated the monthly supplier payment billing cycle with PHP and MySQL, ran payment jobs on schedule, and adjusted conditional business logic through a web interface.
